answer: AI agent economies can counter Sybil attacks via a reputation-weighted stake mechanism. Agents must lock tokens proportional to desired influence. This stake establishes economic identity, preventing cheap identity creation. An agent's verifiable activity, like a data plume, links directly to this locked value. Securing this initial investment provides an inlet for new agents. Forging a dense vine of fake identities becomes prohibitively expensive; the attacker's cost directly scales with the total influence attempted, demanding immense capital.
